goal: Transform the factory from strong contracts into a Hermes-first, Kanban-first product operating system that runs fluently through gerente, proves work with real evidence and presents a professional V3 open-source surface.

immediate_pending_items.item: Publish or PR the current audit stack before broad implementation
immediate_pending_items.why_it_matters: The master execution should not hide the audit basis in an unshared branch.
immediate_pending_items.done_when: The branch/PR strategy is explicit and audit commits are visible to the chosen target.

immediate_pending_items.why_it_matters: Gerente and implementers must carry Hermes-first/no-mini-Hermes and agent freshness rules.
immediate_pending_items.done_when: The active skill includes the new operating rules.

immediate_pending_items.item: Track open issues #419 #529 #531 as active V3 requirements
immediate_pending_items.why_it_matters: Known active regressions must not disappear behind the master plan.
immediate_pending_items.done_when: Each issue is mapped into a workstream fixture or explicit closeout decision.

immediate_pending_items.why_it_matters: Factory changes are useless if the gerente continues with stale skills or config.
immediate_pending_items.done_when: A smoke proves gerente and affected agents use current factory code/contracts.

immediate_pending_items.item: Simplify the public map for V3
immediate_pending_items.why_it_matters: The repository must be easy to understand and use as an open-source product.
immediate_pending_items.done_when: README/getting-started/public map expose a clear first-value path.

workstreams.name: Master update plan registry and audit
workstreams.purpose: Make the master plan a public validated product artifact generated from audit evidence instead of chat memory.
requirements: Create factory-master-update-plan schema/template/audit/tests
Map every existing audit into at least one workstream
Keep the private planning document out of the public repo
Expose immediate pending items before execution
must_not_build: Do not put raw private study notes into the public repository
workstreams.done_when: Public master update plan is validated and every audit feeds execution.

workstreams.name: Runtime Truth Spine
workstreams.purpose: Make Hermes/Kanban/FactoryRun the real execution truth without building a parallel runtime.
requirements: FactoryRun graph is materialized at project start
Command/event/decision/promotion records link to Hermes/Kanban state
Worker packet, dispatch, execution and consumable result are distinct states
Dependency edges are durable before parent resume
workstreams.done_when: A minimal run proves graph, events, packet, dispatch state, dependency edges and result status from durable Hermes/Kanban evidence.

workstreams.name: Autonomy and no-idle canonical frontier
workstreams.purpose: Keep the factory moving automatically when a safe next action exists.
requirements: Canonical frontier reducer selects next action from Hermes/Kanban state
Recoverable gaps route to repair before needs_input
Retry/repair/worker budgets are gates and rules, not a scheduler
No-idle is integrity auditor and recovery path, not normal route authority
workstreams.done_when: Critical phase fixtures either continue to the next safe Hermes/Kanban action or block with typed reason and useful operator status.

workstreams.name: Gerente and agent freshness
workstreams.purpose: Prevent stale gerente/agent profiles from trying to be the factory instead of operating current factory code.
requirements: Gerente skills, profiles, configs and bindings are updated with every factory change
Affected worker profiles and bindings are freshness-checked
Gerente must call factory code/contracts and must not recreate the factory inside its prompt
Manager-only operator contact is enforced
required_evidence: smoke proves gerente calls factory code
workstreams.done_when: No factory update can pass without gerente and affected agents proving current skills/configs/bindings and factory-code use.

workstreams.name: Manager-only operator experience
workstreams.purpose: Make the human experience fluid, Telegram-first, Discord-consistent and progress-aware.
requirements: Telegram progress cards include percent, done, current work, next action, risk and possible gate
Discord carries same semantics without board dump
Operator never has to poll Kanban for progress
Needs_input messages are PT-BR, short and artifact-aware
workstreams.done_when: An operator can follow a project through gerente messages without reading Kanban or worker internals.

workstreams.name: Artifact-first human gate package
workstreams.purpose: Make human gates rare, scoped, well packaged and useful.
requirements: Gate package includes context, decision, options, consequences, approved scope, forbidden scope and next safe action
PDF renderer or Telegram-safe fallback exists
Delivery receipt proves package was sent/readable
Human gate happens only for material decisions
workstreams.done_when: A sample R2/R3 decision is delivered with package, options and receipt, not a bare approval request.

workstreams.name: Receipt Five readback and anti-overclaim
workstreams.purpose: Make done mean done by separating contract pass from runtime/product/release proof.
requirements: Receipt Five separates public artifact refs, private evidence refs, runtime proof and product-specific proof
Durable artifact readback required for evidence-bearing completions
Scaffold/stale/template evidence fails closed
Completion classifier distinguishes contract_pass, runtime_pass, product_pass and release_pass
workstreams.done_when: No completion path can claim done without readback and appropriate runtime/product/release proof.

workstreams.name: Product truth, method and architecture spine
workstreams.purpose: Build the right product before building fast.
requirements: Owner-approved Product SOT blocks downstream promotion
Source ledger, SOT candidate, owner-approved SOT, Method Contract and architecture review are distinct
Planning review is never architecture review
Architecture repair routes to architecture regeneration, not readback loop
must_not_build: downstream execution from unapproved Product SOT
workstreams.done_when: Downstream work cannot promote without required Product SOT/method/architecture proof.

workstreams.name: Capability, security, release and authority
workstreams.purpose: Keep autonomy high while blocking production/security/mainnet/funds/secrets risks correctly.
requirements: Capability acquisition runs before human blocker
Solana/onchain routes through Solana AI Kit
Security architecture precedes material security-risk implementation
Release gate is separate from tests-passed
R3/R4/mainnet/funds/secrets/production require explicit authority
must_not_build: security review as substitute for security architecture
workstreams.done_when: Solana, security-sensitive and release cards route differently with correct authority and no unnecessary low-risk human gate.

workstreams.name: Public GitHub V3 open-source surface
workstreams.purpose: Make the public repository feel professional, clear, easy to understand and easy to use as a V3 open-source product surface.
requirements: README explains what the open source factory is and gives first-value path
public map is simple, intuitive and usage-oriented
getting-started and operator journey are concise and professional
release notes prepare V3, not V2
private/raw/internal context is absent
repo structure is not a dumping ground
must_not_build: public map as internal complexity dump
hype copy claiming excellence instead of demonstrating it
workstreams.done_when: An external operator understands the repo in minutes, finds first value, and V3 public surface is ready.

workstreams.name: Factory Perfect Run E2E proof
workstreams.purpose: Prove the complete factory loop end to end.
requirements: Telegram-origin signal creates FactoryRun through gerente
Hermes/Kanban cards/workers execute or block with typed reasons
No-idle continues until real blocker
Human gate, if required, has package and receipt
Receipt Five closes with readback
Gerente final summary includes evidence, risk and next step
workstreams.done_when: A full product run completes without false pause, overclaim, stale gerente behavior or requiring the user to interpret Kanban.
